title: Mattermost

tagline.en: Team chat — runs with its own PostgreSQL
tagline.es: Chat de equipo: funciona con su propio PostgreSQL
tagline.fr: Chat d'équipe — fonctionne avec son propre PostgreSQL
tagline.pt: Chat de equipa — funciona com o seu próprio PostgreSQL
tagline.ja: チームチャット — 専用の PostgreSQL 付きで動作
tagline.ru: Командный чат — работает со своим PostgreSQL
tagline.hi: टीम चैट — अपने PostgreSQL के साथ चलता है

notes: The first registered account becomes the system admin; the site URL drives invitations, password resets and mobile connections.
Named config, data and plugins volumes preserve System Console edits, uploads and server-side plugins across rebuilds.
The image also declares logs and client/plugins: naming them prevents anonymous volumes and preserves the browser half of installed plugins.
The 1g memory floor supports the in-memory channel index for a small team.
